title_zh: 认真回应室友对摔门声的不满

scenario.label_zh: 室友噪声争执后的解释与道歉
scenario.goal_zh: 说明关门声的影响并约定夜间轻关门

context_zh: 室友 Owen 与 Tess 谈论前一晚关门声引起的不快。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Did you mean to slam the door last night? It woke me up.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: No. I was carrying two bags and let it close behind me.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Please don’t just shrug. I’m trying to explain why I was upset.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Sorry. That sigh wasn’t meant to dismiss you either. I’ve had a rough morning, but that isn’t your fault.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: I don’t need a long explanation. Could you just close it gently when you come in late?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll keep a hand on it next time, even if I have to put a bag down.
